findings.system: trisomic mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs); autophagy inhibitor; original screen (Tang 2011)
findings.finding: Chloroquine was reported as one of three compounds (with AICAR and 17-AAG) that kill aneuploid but not euploid cells.
findings.sentence: Compounds that cause lethality in aneuploid, but not euploid, cells could therefore provide new cancer therapies. We have identified the energy stress-inducing agent AICAR, the protein folding inhibitor 17-AAG, and the autophagy inhibitor chloroquine as exhibiting this property.
findings.caveats: Abstract does not state in which system chloroquine selectivity was measured (abstract details only AICAR in trisomic MEFs and AICAR+17-AAG in human cancer lines); full text not retrievable (Europe PMC HTTP 500; NCBI record is abstract-only). Direction is tumour-oriented: for a child with constitutional mosaic aneuploidy this is a TOXICITY signal, not a benefit (inference).
findings.title: Identification of aneuploidy-selective antiproliferation compounds.

findings.system: trisomic MEFs (secondary citation of Tang 2011 inside Santaguida 2015; human RPE-1 data in same paper)
findings.finding: Trisomic MEFs were more sensitive to chloroquine than euploid cells; increased lysosomal load is proposed to contribute to the fitness loss of primary aneuploid cells.
findings.sentence: MEFs trisomic for either chromosome 1, 13, 16, or 19 exhibit a higher degree of sensitivity to the lysosome inhibitor chloroquine than euploid cells
findings.caveats: Sentence cites Tang et al. 2011; it is not new data. The same paper shows aneuploid RPE-1 cells (also after Mad2 or Bub1 knockdown) have reduced LC3-II flux and a lysosomal stress response, the proposed mechanism for the sensitivity (not tested directly with chloroquine killing here).
findings.title: Aneuploidy-induced cellular stresses limit autophagic degradation.

findings.system: murine aneuploid cells (restated in a human constitutional-trisomy paper, 2021)
findings.finding: Restates selective chloroquine sensitivity of murine aneuploid cells.
findings.sentence: Moreover, murine aneuploid cells were selectively sensitive to treatment with chloroquine, a drug that impairs lysosomal function and thus blocks autophagic degradation
findings.caveats: Secondary citation (mouse). In the same paper human trisomic lines had autophagic flux generally unaffected (see against_or_risk), so the vulnerability may not transfer to every human trisomic line. No chloroquine experiment was done in that paper.
findings.title: Genotoxic stress in constitutive trisomies induces autophagy and the innate immune response via the cGAS-STING pathway.

findings.system: reversine-induced aneuploid non-transformed human fibroblasts (BJ-hTERT, IMR90) and cancer lines (Cancer Discov 2024)
findings.finding: Aneuploidized NON-transformed fibroblast lines were more sensitive to the approved proteasome inhibitor bortezomib.
findings.sentence: Reversine-induced aneuploidization of two near-diploid non-transformed cell lines (BJ-hTERT and IMR90) and three near-diploid cancer cell lines (CAL51, SW48 and HCT116) rendered four of the five cell lines more sensitive to bortezomib
findings.caveats: Directly relevant to the harm side: non-cancer aneuploid cells were more sensitive, so bortezomib would be expected to be more toxic to aneuploid cells, not protective (inference). Aneuploidy induced by reversine (an MPS1 inhibitor), not by BUB1B loss.
findings.title: Increased RNA and Protein Degradation Is Required for Counteracting Transcriptional Burden and Proteotoxic Stress in Human Aneuploid Cells.

findings.system: isogenic RPE1 clones with different aneuploidy levels (Cancer Discov 2024)
findings.finding: Highly aneuploid RPE1 clones were more sensitive to proteasome inhibition than pseudo-diploid counterparts; the text describes bortezomib as clinically approved.
findings.sentence: The highly-aneuploid clones were significantly more sensitive to proteasome inhibition than their pseudo-diploid counterparts
findings.caveats: RPE1 is a non-transformed hTERT epithelial line; clones were derived by inducing missegregation. Sensitivity was measured with bortezomib and MG132. Clinical translation to a child with mosaic aneuploidy is not assessed.
findings.title: Increased RNA and Protein Degradation Is Required for Counteracting Transcriptional Burden and Proteotoxic Stress in Human Aneuploid Cells.

findings.system: cell-line panels and multiple myeloma patients (abstract, Cancer Discov 2024)
findings.finding: Abstract links aneuploidy level to myeloma patient response to proteasome inhibitors (class-level; bortezomib is not named in the abstract).
findings.sentence: At the protein level, aneuploid cells mitigate proteotoxic stress by reducing protein translation and increasing protein degradation, rendering them more sensitive to proteasome inhibition.
findings.title: Increased RNA and Protein Degradation Is Required for Counteracting Transcriptional Burden and Proteotoxic Stress in Human Aneuploid Cells.

findings.system: human trisomy 21 fibroblasts (CCL-54, CCL-84) vs normal fibroblasts, in vitro
findings.finding: Metformin reduced oxidative-damage readouts and raised antioxidant capacity in trisomy 21 fibroblasts (constitutional aneuploidy).
findings.sentence: Our results demonstrate that metformin treatment significantly reduced total oxidative capacity (TOC) and levels of oxidative DNA/RNA damage products in T21 cell lines (CCL-84 and CCL-54).
findings.caveats: Constitutional trisomy 21, not MVA or BUB1B. Only oxidative stress and AMPK-NF-kB markers were measured; no proteotoxic, growth or viability readout. Single in vitro study. An opposite signal exists: AMPK activation (AICAR) kills aneuploid cells in other systems.
findings.title: Metformin modulates oxidative stress via activation of AMPK/NF-κB signaling in Trisomy 21 fibroblasts: an in vitro study.

findings.system: TNBC cell line MDA-MB-231 plus MPS1/TTK inhibitor (cancer, in vitro and xenograft)
findings.finding: Metformin (indirect AMPK activator) combined with an MPS1 inhibitor reduced viability of a TNBC line more than either alone; the paper builds on the idea that aneuploid cells are vulnerable to AMPK-driven energy stress.
findings.sentence: The viability of MDA-MB-231 cells treated with the combination of AICAR or metformin with CFI-402257 was reduced significantly compared with that of cells treated with all drugs alone
findings.caveats: Cancer cell line with an MPS1 inhibitor (not approved); metformin was not compared between aneuploid and euploid cells. Suggests energy stress adds to CIN-induced killing (a harm signal for CIN-prone cells) but is not evidence about children or constitutional mosaicism.
findings.title: Energy‑stress‑mediated activation of AMPK sensitizes MPS1 kinase inhibition in triple‑negative breast cancer.

findings.system: Drosophila larval brain, neural-stem-cell depletion of SAC genes bub3 or rod (CIN/MVA-like microcephaly model); rapamycin = SIROLIMUS in universe
findings.finding: Feeding the TOR inhibitor rapamycin (like genetic autophagy boosting) rescued the number of aneuploid neuroblasts in a SAC-gene CIN fly brain.
findings.sentence: A similar result was obtained by feeding larvae with the TOR inhibitor Rapamycin
findings.caveats: Fly; SAC genes bub3/rod, not BUBR1. "Similar result" refers to rescue of neuroblast number by autophagy-boosting interventions. Rescue did NOT extend to Pros+ cell number or larval brain size, and the authors warn TOR inhibition might be detrimental to highly aneuploid neuroblasts (see against_or_risk).
findings.title: Proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly.

findings.finding: In mice with monoallelic BubR1 mutations, predisposition to sarcopenia correlated with mTORC1 hyperactivity; no mTOR inhibitor was given in the abstract.
findings.sentence: Additionally, mice carrying monoallelic BubR1 mutations were prone to select MVA-related pathologies later in life, with predisposition to sarcopenia correlating with mTORC1 hyperactivity.
findings.caveats: Correlation only (L0 for sirolimus): no drug rescue in the abstract. Model phenotypes (dwarfism, lipodystrophy, sarcopenia) overlap with the child but alleles differ from p.Leu737* / p.Asn1002Lys.
findings.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome.

findings.system: human primary fibroblasts from individuals with Down syndrome, with the non-approved mTOR kinase inhibitor AZD8055
findings.finding: mTOR hyperactivation suppresses autophagy/mitophagy in trisomy 21 fibroblasts; a non-approved mTORC1/2 inhibitor restored flux. Supports the class mechanism for sirolimus without testing sirolimus.
findings.sentence: Notably, inhibition of mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) and complex 2 (mTORC2) using AZD8055 (AZD) restores autophagy flux, PARKIN/PINK initiation of mitophagy, and the clearance of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy.
findings.caveats: Tested drug (AZD8055) is not approved; sirolimus not tested. Constitutional trisomy 21, not MVA. L0 for sirolimus by class inference.
findings.title: mTOR hyperactivation in Down Syndrome underlies deficits in autophagy induction, autophagosome formation, and mitophagy.

findings.system: trisomy 21 and trisomy 13 patient iPSC-derived neurons; sodium 4-phenylbutyrate (chemical chaperone)
findings.finding: A chemical chaperone (sodium 4-phenylbutyrate) reduced protein aggregates and apoptosis in trisomic neurons: stress relief in constitutional aneuploidy.
findings.sentence: Intriguingly, treatment with sodium 4-phenylbutyrate, a chemical chaperone, successfully decreased the formation of protein aggregates and prevented the progression of cell apoptosis in trisomic neurons.
findings.caveats: Sodium 4-phenylbutyrate is NOT in universe.json under that name (only GLYCEROL PHENYLBUTYRATE, a different entry), so it is registered in not_approved and not asserted as approved here. Neurons from trisomy 21/13, iPSC model; unrelated to BUB1B.
findings.title: 4-Phenylbutyrate ameliorates apoptotic neural cell death in Down syndrome by reducing protein aggregates.

findings.system: human lymphocytes, in vitro genotoxicity battery (Ames, comet, cytokinesis-block micronucleus)
findings.finding: HCQ did not induce DNA damage or excess micronuclei in human lymphocytes in vitro but was cytostatic (reduced nuclear division index).
findings.sentence: HCQ induced pronounced dose-dependent cytostasis, evidenced by a 20.5% reduction in Nuclear Division Index at 40 μg/mL, without accompanying genotoxicity.
findings.caveats: Euploid lymphocytes; not aneuploid cells and no autophagy endpoints. Included as a safety note: cytostasis could matter in a child with growth failure (inference).
findings.title: The Genotoxic Ambiguity of 4-Aminoquinolines: Resolving Hydroxychloroquine's Mechanistic Safety Profile Through Integrated Toxicology Assessment.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid yeast are under proteotoxic stress.
background_evidence.sentence: We found that aneuploid budding yeast cells are under proteotoxic stress.
background_evidence.caveats: Yeast only; cannot be applied to human cells. Re-verified from abstract.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy causes proteotoxic stress in yeast.

background_evidence.finding: Proteasome and Hsp90 are compromised in many aneuploid yeast strains.
background_evidence.sentence: Protein aggregate formation in aneuploid yeast strains is likely due to limiting protein quality-control systems, since the proteasome and at least one chaperone family, Hsp90, are compromised in many aneuploid strains.
background_evidence.caveats: Yeast only; "likely due to" is the authors' inference.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy causes proteotoxic stress in yeast.

background_evidence.finding: Human aneuploid cells have impaired HSP90-dependent folding and HSF1 deficiency.
background_evidence.sentence: Here, we report that human aneuploid cells are impaired in HSP90-mediated protein folding.
background_evidence.caveats: Implies HSP90 inhibition would add to folding stress (inference); no HSP90 inhibitor is in the approved universe.
background_evidence.title: HSF1 deficiency and impaired HSP90-dependent protein folding are hallmarks of aneuploid human cells.

background_evidence.system: human aneuploid RPE-1 cells and trisomic MEFs; Mad2/Bub1 knockdown
background_evidence.finding: Autophagosomal cargo accumulates in lysosomes of aneuploid cells (lysosomal stress response through TFEB).
background_evidence.sentence: Here we show that autophagosomal cargo such as protein aggregates accumulate within lysosomes in aneuploid cells.
background_evidence.caveats: Cell lines; the full text notes many cancer lines show no clearance defect.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy-induced cellular stresses limit autophagic degradation.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cells accumulate p62 bodies, impaired folding, altered proteasomal/lysosomal activity and mitochondrial defects.
background_evidence.sentence: Aneuploid cells accumulate SQSTM1/p62-positive cytosolic bodies, exhibit impaired protein folding, and show altered proteasomal and lysosomal activity.
background_evidence.caveats: Heat shock protein overexpression mitigated aggregation; no approved drug tested.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy-induced proteostasis disruption impairs mitochondrial functions and mediates aggregation of mitochondrial precursor proteins through SQSTM1/p62.

background_evidence.finding: Subunit stoichiometry imbalance drives aggregation and thus proteotoxic stress.
background_evidence.sentence: Our study explains why proteotoxic stress is a universal feature of the aneuploid state and reveals protein aggregation as a form of dosage compensation to cope with disproportionate expression of protein complex subunits.
background_evidence.caveats: Authors' claim of universality; contradicted for some yeast karyotypes (see against_or_risk).
background_evidence.title: Protein aggregation mediates stoichiometry of protein complexes in aneuploid cells.

background_evidence.system: human trisomic cell lines and primary trisomic MEFs
background_evidence.finding: Constitutional trisomy upregulates autophagy/lysosomal genes via cGAS-STING-dependent TFEB nuclear localization.
background_evidence.sentence: Constitutive nuclear localization of TFEB in trisomic cells is independent of mTORC1 signaling, but depends on the cGAS-STING activation.
background_evidence.caveats: Autophagy is upregulated, not impaired, in these lines.
background_evidence.title: Genotoxic stress in constitutive trisomies induces autophagy and the innate immune response via the cGAS-STING pathway.

background_evidence.system: Drosophila neural stem cells, SAC gene depletion (MVA model)
background_evidence.finding: In an MVA-like fly model, proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to loss of stemness.
background_evidence.sentence: We unravel a contribution of proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction to the negative impact of complex aneuploidies on stemness, a highly energy demanding cellular state.
background_evidence.caveats: Fly model; abstract rescues are genetic (ROS scavengers, mitochondrial chaperones); rapamycin appears only in the full text.
background_evidence.title: Proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly.

background_evidence.system: human aneuploid cell models and cancer lines
background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cells reduce translation and increase RNA/protein degradation to cope with imbalance.
background_evidence.sentence: At the protein level, aneuploid cells mitigate proteotoxic stress by reducing protein translation and increasing protein degradation, rendering them more sensitive to proteasome inhibition.
background_evidence.caveats: Same source as the bortezomib findings.
background_evidence.title: Increased RNA and Protein Degradation Is Required for Counteracting Transcriptional Burden and Proteotoxic Stress in Human Aneuploid Cells.

background_evidence.system: human cells with siBubR1 plus CENP-E inhibitor (SAC-attenuated)
background_evidence.finding: In SAC-attenuated (BubR1-depleted) cells, aneuploidy causes proteotoxic stress and DNA damage.
background_evidence.sentence: Pharmacological studies reveal that aneuploidy caused by the CENP-E inhibitor, Compound-A, in SAC-attenuated cells causes substantial proteotoxic stress and DNA damage.
background_evidence.caveats: Closest human BUBR1-depletion evidence for proteotoxic stress; SAC attenuation here is by siBubR1 and the aneuploidy is induced by a CENP-E inhibitor, not a BUB1B variant.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy generates proteotoxic stress and DNA damage concurrently with p53-mediated post-mitotic apoptosis in SAC-impaired cells.

background_evidence.finding: BUBR1 deficiency enhances insulin sensitivity in mice (checkpoint proteins link to energy metabolism).
background_evidence.sentence: BUBR1 deficiency enhances insulin sensitivity in mice.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse; an energy-metabolism link independent of aneuploidy. Direction for metformin not tested.
background_evidence.title: Mitotic Checkpoint Regulators Control Insulin Signaling and Metabolic Homeostasis.

background_evidence.system: aneuploid human mammary epithelial cell lines (CRISPR screen)
background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cells depend on pyrimidine synthesis and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation genes.
background_evidence.sentence: Our study reveals that aneuploid HMECs exhibit an increased reliance on pyrimidine biosynthesis and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation genes and demonstrate heightened fitness advantages upon loss of tumor suppressor genes.
background_evidence.caveats: Epithelial lines enriched for cancer-associated CNAs; energy/nucleotide dependency.
background_evidence.title: Aneuploidy generates enhanced nucleotide dependency and sensitivity to metabolic perturbation.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid yeast show ribosome-quality-control defects and aggregates.
background_evidence.sentence: We show that aneuploids entering quiescence display aberrant ribosome profiles, accumulate RQC intermediates, and harbor an increased load of protein aggregates compared to euploid cells.
background_evidence.title: Chromosome duplication causes premature aging via defects in ribosome quality control.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cells in mosaic mouse embryos are eliminated through autophagy and apoptosis (p53-dependent).
background_evidence.sentence: Here, using a mouse model of chromosome mosaicism, we show that aneuploid cells are preferentially eliminated from the embryonic lineage in a p53-dependent process involving both autophagy and apoptosis before, during and after implantation.
background_evidence.caveats: Embryo model; autophagy contributes to clearing aneuploid cells, which argues against blanket autophagy inhibition (inference).
background_evidence.title: Autophagy-mediated apoptosis eliminates aneuploid cells in a mouse model of chromosome mosaicism.

background_evidence.finding: mTOR hyperactivation suppresses autophagy and mitophagy in trisomy 21 fibroblasts.
background_evidence.sentence: Secondly, mTOR is strongly hyper-activated, which globally suppresses macroautophagy induction and the transcriptional expression of proteins critical for autophagosome formation such as ATG7, ATG3 and FOXO1.
background_evidence.title: mTOR hyperactivation in Down Syndrome underlies deficits in autophagy induction, autophagosome formation, and mitophagy.

background_evidence.finding: General effects of aneuploidy include proteotoxic stress and altered metabolism, in cancer and congenital syndromes.
background_evidence.sentence: General effects refer to the common cellular stresses induced by aneuploidy, such as impaired proliferation, proteotoxic stress, and altered metabolism, which occur regardless of the specific chromosome involved and profoundly impact cellular and organismal functions.
background_evidence.title: The Hallmarks of Aneuploidy in Cancer and Congenital Syndromes.

background_evidence.finding: Aneuploid cancer cells resist ROS through PARP1 suppression; lysosomal dysfunction is upstream.
background_evidence.sentence: Furthermore, we found that lysosomal dysfunction serves as the upstream mediator of CEBPB activation in aneuploid cells.
background_evidence.caveats: [PREPRINT, not peer reviewed; id PPR1068326] Cancer models.
background_evidence.title: PARP1 Suppression Drives ROS Resistance in Aneuploid Cancer Cells

background_evidence.finding: PRMT5:MEP50 protects CIN cancer cells from aggregation and reduces sensitivity to proteasome inhibitors.
background_evidence.sentence: Accordingly, concomitant PRMT5:MEP50 expression renders cancer cells less sensitive to proteasome inhibitors and CIN while inhibition sensitizes cells to CIN.
background_evidence.caveats: [PREPRINT, not peer reviewed; id PPR1085726] PRMT5 inhibitors are not in the approved universe.
background_evidence.title: Increased activity of PRMT5-MEP50 complex improves survival of chromosomally unstable cancer cells by increasing tolerance to protein aggregation and proteotoxicity

background_evidence.system: PREPRINT, isogenic aneuploid cancer lines (CRISPR screens)
background_evidence.finding: Proteasome subunits and mitochondrial metabolism are aneuploid-specific dependency groups.
background_evidence.sentence: Seven genome-wide paired screens identified ribosomes, rRNA processing, spliceosome-mediated RNA processing, proteasome subunits, and mitochondrial metabolism as top aneuploid-specific dependency gene groups.
background_evidence.caveats: [PREPRINT, not peer reviewed; id PPR1213099] Cancer lines.
background_evidence.title: Paired CRISPR screens identify mitochondrial metabolism and UBE2H as aneuploid-specific dependencies in human cancer cell lines

not_approved.role: energy-stress AMPK activator; kills aneuploid cells (21315436, 22890317; with MPS1 inhibitor 38904203)
not_approved.note: Not matched in data/universe.json under tested names; "not approved" is limited to that file.
Not in universe.json. Also directionally unfavourable: aneuploid cells already have impaired HSP90 folding (25205676).

not_approved.role: research proteasome inhibitor used in aneuploid-cell studies
mTORC1/2 kinase inhibitor restoring autophagy in trisomy 21 fibroblasts
chemical chaperone, reduced aggregates in trisomic neurons
not_approved.note: GLYCEROL PHENYLBUTYRATE is in universe.json as a different entry; no aneuploidy study tested it. Not used as a candidate.

not_approved.role: antioxidant rescuing Mad2-depletion aneuploidy phenotype in Drosophila GABAergic neurons
not_approved.note: ACETYLCYSTEINE (NAC) is in universe.json but was NOT the compound tested; no NAC evidence in aneuploid cells found.

not_approved.role: raises BubR1 abundance in mice; SIRT2 overexpression extends lifespan of BubR1 H/H mice
not_approved.note: Abstract: "Overexpression of SIRT2 or treatment of mice with the NAD(+) precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) increases BubR1 abundance in vivo." Aging-mouse context.

no_evidence: No study found in which metformin, chloroquine, hydroxychloroquine, bortezomib, carfilzomib or sirolimus was tested in human cells with a BUB1B/BUBR1 defect or in cells from MVA patients (MVA/BUB1B plus drug queries returned nothing relevant).
No BubR1 hypomorphic mouse (H/H or allelic series) treated with an approved drug was found; the interventions found were genetic SIRT2 overexpression and NMN (not approved).
No clinical observation (L3) of these drugs in MVA or BUB1B patients was found in these searches.
No primary study of chloroquine/HCQ, metformin or proteasome inhibitors in aneuploid rhabdomyosarcoma models was found with the queries used.
No evidence found that autophagy inhibitors (chloroquine/HCQ) relieve, rather than worsen, stress in aneuploid cells; all chloroquine experiments found are selective-killing experiments.
No study found testing HSP90-pathway modulation, trehalose, spermidine or lithium in aneuploid or MVA cells.
No study found linking aneuploidy-associated proteotoxic stress to nephrocalcinosis, prematurity or SGA.

Full text of Tang 2011 (21315436), the yeast paper 23222101 and Donnelly 2014 (25205676) was not retrievable (Europe PMC HTTP 500; NCBI PMC record abstract-only), so only abstract sentences were verified for them.
No data on the specific variants p.Leu737* / p.Asn1002Lys with any drug; phase unresolved.

against_or_risk.finding: Autophagic flux was generally unaffected in human trisomic lines, arguing against a universal flux defect (so a lysosomal vulnerability to chloroquine is not guaranteed).
against_or_risk.sentence: This analysis showed that autophagic flux was generally unaffected in aneuploid cells, with LC3-II increasing to a similar level or more after bafilomycin treatment than in the parental diploid control
against_or_risk.caveats: Constitutional trisomic lines; conflicts with the flux defect reported in RPE-1 after induced missegregation (Santaguida 2015).
against_or_risk.title: Genotoxic stress in constitutive trisomies induces autophagy and the innate immune response via the cGAS-STING pathway.

against_or_risk.finding: Many cancer cell lines show no autophagy-clearance defect after missegregation; lysosome limitation may not generalise.
against_or_risk.sentence: Our initial efforts to address this question led to the remarkable finding that many cancer cell lines do not experience LC3-II clearance defects following chromosome missegregation
against_or_risk.caveats: The authors cite their own unpublished data; weak evidence.
against_or_risk.title: Aneuploidy-induced cellular stresses limit autophagic degradation.

against_or_risk.system: Drosophila CIN brain (rapamycin and autophagy boosting)
against_or_risk.finding: Authors warn TOR inhibition or non-physiological autophagy might hurt proliferative capacity of highly aneuploid neuroblasts; autophagy boosting did not rescue brain size.
against_or_risk.sentence: These results suggest that TOR inhibition or non-physiological levels of autophagy might have a negative impact on the proliferative capacity of highly aneuploid NBs.
against_or_risk.caveats: Tied to the SIROLIMUS finding: any benefit of mTOR inhibition is partial and might reduce growth, relevant to a child with growth retardation (inference).
against_or_risk.title: Proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly.

against_or_risk.system: siBubR1 human cells with CENP-E inhibitor
against_or_risk.finding: BubR1-depleted aneuploid cells were NOT sensitised by the proteasome inhibitor MG132 (UPR lowered translation), so bortezomib hypersensitivity may not hold in every SAC-defective context. MG132 is not an approved drug.
against_or_risk.sentence: Accordingly, MG132 treatment neither enhanced caspase-3/7 levels nor caused growth inhibition in these aneuploid cells
against_or_risk.caveats: Research proteasome inhibitor (MG132), not bortezomib; the cell line was not verified in this review. Shows context dependence.
against_or_risk.title: Aneuploidy generates proteotoxic stress and DNA damage concurrently with p53-mediated post-mitotic apoptosis in SAC-impaired cells.

against_or_risk.finding: Proteotoxic stress is not an obligate consequence of aneuploidy: some yeast karyotypes tolerate it without stress responses.
against_or_risk.sentence: We suggest that proteotoxic stress, while common, is not always an obligate consequence of aneuploidy, but rather certain karyotypes and genetic backgrounds may be able to tolerate the excess protein burden placed on the protein homeostasis machinery.
against_or_risk.caveats: Yeast only; limits generality of the proteotoxic premise.
against_or_risk.title: Aneuploidy-induced proteotoxic stress can be effectively tolerated without dosage compensation, genetic mutations, or stress responses.

against_or_risk.system: aneuploid yeast with active environmental stress response
against_or_risk.finding: Suppressing the stress response in aneuploid yeast lowered viability under extra proteotoxicity: extra proteotoxic hits are poorly tolerated.
against_or_risk.sentence: Suppression of the ESR in aneuploid cells resulted in longer cell doubling times and decreased viability in the presence of additional proteotoxicity.
against_or_risk.caveats: Yeast; the harm reading for human proteasome inhibitors is an inference.
against_or_risk.title: Cell adaptation to aneuploidy by the environmental stress response dampens induction of the cytosolic unfolded-protein response.

against_or_risk.system: trisomic MEFs and aneuploid cell models
against_or_risk.finding: Risk reading: lysosome inhibition is selectively toxic to aneuploid cells in at least the MEF system, so chloroquine/HCQ could harm aneuploid cell clones in a mosaic child; direction not tested in humans.
against_or_risk.sentence: Moreover, murine aneuploid cells were selectively sensitive to treatment with chloroquine, a drug that impairs lysosomal function and thus blocks autophagic degradation
against_or_risk.caveats: The risk reading is an inference (L0 for the child); the underlying mouse observation is L1.
against_or_risk.title: Genotoxic stress in constitutive trisomies induces autophagy and the innate immune response via the cGAS-STING pathway.

notes: Hypotheses to investigate only; not evidence of benefit and not medical advice. No doses are given.
